veranderings.na: aan watter geloof die mense daar behoort
veranderings.rede: A faith is not what is worshipped, so 'watter geloof daar aanbid word' is illogical; the replacement keeps the meaning.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: wat met die hand geskryf word
veranderings.na: wat met die hand geskryf is
veranderings.rede: The scroll is already written, so the state passive 'is' fits better and matches the glossary entry.
'Voorlees' already means reading aloud, so 'hardop' is redundant.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: rye banke en 'n tafel of preekstoel voor
veranderings.na: rye banke en voorin 'n tafel of preekstoel
veranderings.rede: 'het ... voor' at the end can read as the verb 'voorhê'; 'voorin' placed before the noun is clear.
'met die naam minaret' is a wooden calque of 'by the name of'; 'wat 'n minaret genoem word' is natural Afrikaans.

veranderings.voor: lê matte op die vloer en mense
veranderings.na: lê matte op die vloer, en mense
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
'ver in' reads as 'deep inside'; 'ver weg in' says it is far away, which is the intended meaning.

veranderings.voor: na 'n gebou met die naam tempel
veranderings.na: na 'n gebou wat 'n tempel genoem word
veranderings.rede: Same wooden 'met die naam' construction as in the Islam block; this is the natural phrasing.

veranderings.voor: brand voor die altaar en die mense
veranderings.na: brand voor die altaar, en die mense
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Om te herken en te eerbiedig
veranderings.voor: sonder om self daar te bid
veranderings.na: sonder om self in 'n moskee of sinagoge te bid
veranderings.rede: 'daar' has no place to refer to, since a minaret and a menora are not places of prayer; the buildings are the ones the lesson already names.
The definite article suggests there is only one synagogue; a definition of a kind of building takes 'n'.
The definite article suggests there is only one mosque; a definition of a kind of building takes 'n'.

veranderings.voor: in Hindoeïsme wat ook 'n klank is
veranderings.na: in Hindoeïsme. Dit is ook 'n klank
veranderings.rede: 'wat' directly after 'Hindoeïsme' can be read as Hinduism being a sound; a second sentence makes it clear the sign is the sound.
